rules: Developer compensation is calculated only from net protocol revenue retained by an eligible application after provider, network, refund and user obligations.
The V1 DevelopmentCompensationVault420 rejects any declared developer allocation above 10 percent of declared net protocol revenue.
Every contribution carries source application identity, an application revenue reference and a policy reference.
Only source contracts explicitly authorized through CapabilityRegistry420 may contribute.
The vault atomically forwards accepted native or exact-transfer ERC-20 compensation to the configured 420 Integrated Labs beneficiary and does not retain routed funds.
The beneficiary wallet is public deployment configuration and is not hidden or duplicated across fee-bearing applications.
Changing the beneficiary requires deployment/governance migration to a new authorized vault version rather than an arbitrary owner redirect.
Application-specific economic policies such as the existing 420Token community-vault allocation remain valid exceptions where explicitly documented.
